explanation: Most consistent strong trigger is a mid-word subword fragment of a proper name or brand, often containing b/u sounds (H-obb, D-ub-ai, Hub-spot, A-BB-Y, T-udy, Marg-ie); the remaining strong excerpts (complete, fright, in, a paragraph break) and all moderate ones (digits after $, most, bottom, ')') do not share this or any other single trigger.
